experiment_template.research_question: Does retaining bounded archive recovery after inspection resolve the H18 structural gap within existing budgets?
stop_conditions: No provider calls, retries or substitution of baseline failures.
Stop on source drift, receipt mismatch or fixture effect.

success_criteria.delayed: Candidate 27/27 valid delayed cases correct with decisive evidence in selected final prompt
success_criteria.missing: Candidate 9/9 invalid references block with no proposal or effect
success_criteria.unknown: Missing exposure or source attribution is inconclusive

falsifier: Any immediate control regresses, valid delayed recovery remains impossible or exceeds budget, or invalid archive references yield an accepted proposal.
mechanism: Submission no longer removes the only recovery tool immediately after the generic coverage gate passes; a later read can recover decisive evidence, including after an obsolete read.
scope: Scripted affordance test of an isolated candidate; does not claim model-directed relevance selection or real GLM accuracy improvement.
statement: Offering bounded archive recovery after delivery completion permits an evidence-seeking responder to recover a masked revised fact before submission within existing budgets.
